reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I don't need a new thing to keep track of.
objection: It costs more than what I already buy, and I have no reason to switch from something that works for me.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay for Toplux, around $20 for 30 days, or a free sample so I could try one sachet without spending anything.
